resolve_customer.label: Resolve customer
resolve_customer.objective: Resolve the support case to exactly one customer. First call get_support_case with the supplied case_id. Wait for that call to return. Then call search_customers with the exact case_id, claimed_email, and phone_last4 from get_support_case. Do not call find_candidate_purchases. Select resolved only when exactly one customer matches the claimed identifiers. Copy the case facts, customer_id, and evidence exactly from tool results. Set identity_confidence to 1 only for one exact match. Select manual_required when no match exists, several matches remain, identifiers conflict, or evidence is insufficient. Never guess an identifier.

identify_purchase.label: Identify purchase
identify_purchase.objective: Resolve the customer to exactly one order and payment. Call only find_candidate_purchases. Pass case_id, customer_id, and order_hint exactly from the resolved_customer input. Select identified only when exactly one purchase matches and its customer_id equals the input customer_id. Copy the order_id, payment_id, purchased_at, case facts, customer facts, and evidence exactly from the input and tool result. Select manual_required when no purchase matches, several purchases remain, identifiers conflict, or evidence is insufficient. Never pass an email address as customer_id and never guess an identifier.

gather_refund_facts.label: Gather refund facts
gather_refund_facts.objective: Gather authoritative facts without making a claim classification or remedy decision. Call exactly these five tools with identifiers copied from the purchase input: get_order_facts, get_payment_facts, get_refund_history, get_risk_signals, and get_remedy_options. The calls are independent and can run in parallel. Select ready only when all five calls succeed, every returned identifier matches the purchase input, and each entity lookup reports found true when that field exists. Copy the purchase and all five complete tool results without changing values. Select facts_unavailable when a lookup fails, an identifier conflicts, or evidence is insufficient. Never classify the claim, choose a remedy, or call a write tool.

classify_claim.label: Classify claim
classify_claim.objective: Route the complete refund context by its authoritative claim type. Read refund_context.remedy_options.claim_type and select exactly the matching output: item_issue, delivery_issue, or preference_issue. Do not infer a different type. Copy refund_context unchanged. Cite at least two fact IDs and give a concise summary. Do not select a remedy and do not call a tool.

item_remedy.label: Choose item remedy
item_remedy.objective: Call get_active_refund_policy with region from purchase.region, currency from payment_facts.currency, product_type and purchase_channel from order_facts, and as_of from purchase.case_opened_at. Copy these values exactly and use the complete clauses in the returned policy. Handle only an item_issue. Select original_refund when the customer requests a refund and the STANDARD-30 and AUTO-100 rules apply. Select replacement when the customer requests a replacement, inventory is available, and REPLACEMENT-DAMAGE-1 applies. Set amount_minor to 0 for a replacement because this action does not move money. Require low risk, a settled payment, no active dispute, and consistent identifiers. Copy all other request values from the context, set the exact policy clause IDs, and never call a write tool.

delivery_remedy.label: Choose delivery remedy
delivery_remedy.objective: Call get_active_refund_policy with region from purchase.region, currency from payment_facts.currency, product_type and purchase_channel from order_facts, and as_of from purchase.case_opened_at. Copy these values exactly and use the complete clauses in the returned policy. Handle only a delivery_issue. Select carrier_review when remedy_options.carrier_review_required is true and CARRIER-REVIEW-1 applies; set amount_minor to 0. Otherwise select exception_refund only when conflicting delivery evidence qualifies under DELIVERY-EXCEPTION-2; set approval_mode to manager. Copy all identifiers and evidence from the context and never call a write tool.

preference_remedy.label: Choose preference remedy
preference_remedy.objective: Call get_active_refund_policy with region from purchase.region, currency from payment_facts.currency, product_type and purchase_channel from order_facts, and as_of from purchase.case_opened_at. Copy these values exactly and use the complete clauses in the returned policy. Handle only a preference_issue. Select store_credit when the item is not final sale, the customer requests store credit, risk is low, and STORE-CREDIT-30 applies. Select denied when a hard exclusion such as FINAL-SALE-1 applies. Copy all identifiers and evidence from the context and never call a write tool.

issue_refund.label: Issue refund
issue_refund.objective: Issue one synthetic payment refund. This is the only node with Payment Sandbox access. For a policy request, require the same original_refund object on the authorization input. For a manager request, require authorization.decision to equal approved. Call issue_refund exactly once with refund_request copied without changes from request. Do not supply an idempotency key; the server owns it. Select succeeded only from the exact tool receipt. Do not call any other tool.

create_replacement.label: Create replacement
create_replacement.objective: Create one synthetic replacement effect. Call create_replacement exactly once with request copied without changes from remedy.remedy_request. Select succeeded only from the exact tool receipt. Do not call any other tool and never invent a receipt.

issue_store_credit.label: Issue store credit
issue_store_credit.objective: Create one synthetic store_credit effect. Call issue_store_credit exactly once with request copied without changes from remedy.remedy_request. Select succeeded only from the exact tool receipt. Do not call any other tool and never invent a receipt.

open_carrier_review.label: Open carrier review
open_carrier_review.objective: Create one synthetic carrier_review effect. Call open_carrier_review exactly once with request copied without changes from remedy.remedy_request. Select succeeded only from the exact tool receipt. Do not call any other tool and never invent a receipt.

explain_denial.label: Explain denial
explain_denial.objective: Produce the final denied resolution. Preserve case_id and policy_clause_ids. Set outcome to denied and effect_count to 0. Summarize the customer explanation without claiming that any side effect occurred.

report_outcome.label: Report outcome
report_outcome.objective: Normalize the one terminal result into a case result. Preserve case_id and effect_count. Map a refund receipt to outcome refund and refund_id to effect_id. Map a remedy receipt to its action and action_id. Map a denied resolution to outcome denied and effect_id null. Give a concise summary. Never call a tool or claim an effect not present in the input.
